name: Vatican City

flag.description: A square flag divided vertically into yellow (hoist) and white halves, with the crossed keys of Saint Peter, one gold and one silver, beneath the papal tiara on the white half.
flag.symbolism: Yellow and white recall the gold and silver keys of Saint Peter; the keys and the tiara symbolise the authority of the Pope.

hook: A square gold-and-white flag with crossed keys on the white half: Vatican City holds the keys of Saint Peter, and shares its square shape only with Switzerland.
trivia: Vatican City and Switzerland have the only square national flags.
At about 0.44 square kilometres, Vatican City is the smallest country in the world.
The Pontifical Swiss Guard has protected the Pope since 1506.
